items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to play with him. We used to play at the Allstars for $15 a week.

ctx.x: How did Hillard Brown’s band differ from Bob Tinsley’s?
I think Hillard was a better musician than Bob Tinsley.
You were still playing at the Allstars which you considered not to be one of the finer clubs of Chicago.
